╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║  MediQuiz — how to use your download (pick ONE)              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

★ EASIEST — on your Realme 9i (or any phone/PC):
  1. Send MediQuiz.html to the phone (WhatsApp/Drive/USB).
  2. Open it with Chrome. Done — it runs fully offline already.
     (Optional: Chrome ⋮ → “Add to Home screen” for an app icon.)

★ FULL app with live server API (needs Node.js):
  1. Unzip mediquiz-app.zip.
  2. npm install && npm start
  3. Open http://localhost:8080 — install as PWA.

★ APK wrapper (optional, uses free pwabuilder.com):
  Host the public/ + data/ folders anywhere with HTTPS, feed the
  URL to pwabuilder.com → “Package for Android” → APK download.

Enjoy! 💊🎯
